name: Goan Pork Vindaloo
ingredients: 3 lbs Pork shoulder, butt or loin
8-10 dry red chili peppers (whole Kashmiri red chili peppers)
unmapped: cashews (garnish; no board home - board has almonds/walnuts/peanuts/pistachios only)
ghee (garnish; no board home - approx butter)
coriander seeds (board carries ground-coriander, not whole seed)
Kashmiri dry red chili peppers (specific variety; approx to dried-guajillo/dried-arbol on board)
why: Braised pork-shoulder curry, structurally low-carb (meat + onions + spice paste + vinegar, no rice/potato/legume base). Published 631 cal / 7g carb / 41g protein per serving clears the 400-650 cal, <=35g carb band on the source's own numbers. Adds Goan/Indian cuisine variety absent from the 544-recipe catalog and from this run's accepted pork (carnitas, char siu, kalua, adobo, tinga, green chili, barbacoa are all taken). Scales cleanly to 14 via weigh-and-divide from a Dutch oven / slow cooker.
confidence: Verified nutrition read from page. CAUTION: 631 cal sits near the 650 ceiling driven by 48g fat, so our label-DB recompute could push it over the gate; a leaner trim of the shoulder (source suggests loin alternative) would give margin. Carbs (7g) have wide headroom.
